$comment: The municipal console (§E19), source language. Its own namespace because the register is different from every other surface: the reader is an officer at work, the sentences are instructions and states rather than explanations, and a namespace is the unit the Phase 5 locale registry overrides. Nothing here is a colour, a number, or a format. Nothing here restates a sentence the API returns.
console.title: Console
console.provenanceWhy: Every figure on this sheet traces to a record. Nothing here is typed in by hand.
nav.command.hint: The city and the queue, sorted by what breaches first
nav.review.hint: Reports the pipeline would not decide alone
nav.policy.hint: Rules as documents, with a backtest before they bite
nav.control.hint: Taxonomy, zones, departments, calendars, locales, tenants
nav.developers.hint: Keys, webhooks, usage, and the version clock
nav.area.hint: One ward over time, including what it is not telling us
nav.work.hint: Assignment, the contractor picker, and the rate card
nav.closure.hint: Evidence or nothing — the conditions, shown before they are hit
nav.money.hint: Allocated against spent, and what a citizen sees of it
nav.integrity.hint: Signals, case files, and the requirements a blacklist needs
nav.reports.hint: A document that carries its own proof
nav.roles.hint: What each role sees, and what it may do
palette.title: Go to
palette.hint: Type to filter. Enter opens, Escape closes.
keys.title: Keyboard
keys.evidence: Open the evidence trail for the selected item
reason.perceptual_duplicate: Looks like a photo we have seen
reason.ambiguous_dedup: Too close to call against an existing report
decision.escalate.why: Escalate is not a rejection. It means this needs somebody with more authority than me, and it is recorded as its own outcome.
decision.recorded: Recorded. This item has been judged, and one judgement per item is forever.
decision.failed: That decision was not recorded. Nothing has changed.
item.title: Item {id}
item.mediaNote: Every image on this screen is served from the redacted path. The original is not reachable from a console URL.
item.noMedia: No image was attached to this report.
item.none: Select an item to see it here.
sort.title: Sorted by priority, then oldest first
sort.why: SLA remaining is the sort §E19.1 asks for and the contract does not carry a deadline yet. Rather than derive one that would look measured, the queue states the order it is actually in.
fixture.title: Not wired yet
fixture.body: Every field on this screen is typed against the published contract. The values are fixtures until Phase {phase} populates them, and this notice is how you tell the difference.
fixture.gapWhy: This part of the screen has no shape in openapi.json at all, so there is nothing honest to render — not even a fixture. Naming it is the useful thing to do.
area.title: Ward 22
area.underreporting.body: This ward files {rate} reports per road-kilometre per month against a city median of {median}, with similar road-condition indicators. This is likely under-reporting, not good roads.
area.underreporting.suggested: Suggested: an assisted-reporting drive, and a comparison against 311 phone volume.
area.underreporting.why: §23.1 records reporting bias as a risk. Naming it as a signal on the ward's own screen is what turns a documented concern into something an officer can act on.
work.concentration: {name} has received {share} of road work in {zone} this quarter.
work.concentration.why: This blocks nothing. It makes the pattern impossible to not-know at the moment of the decision, and it is recorded that the assigner saw it.
work.variance.justify: A figure this far above the rate card needs a justification note, and the note becomes part of the record.
closure.title: Closure conditions
closure.enforced: The backend enforces closure. This screen renders the rule; it is not the control.
closure.beforeAfter: A before-and-after pair exists, with the after photograph's location within tolerance
closure.ssim: Verification has run, and its score is printed even when it is ambiguous
closure.ssim.ambiguous: Ambiguous. Printed rather than rounded into a verdict.
money.publicToggle.why: The same figures with suppression applied. Knowing that the internal number and the public number are the same number is the whole point.
integrity.disclaimer: A signal is not a finding. Every card here names the detector that raised it, the threshold it crossed, and how confident that detector is.
integrity.case.attach: Evidence is attached by reference, never pasted. Each item carries its own hash and its source.
integrity.blacklist.why: Blacklisting is never a button. It is the outcome of a completed case, and the requirements are shown rather than the action hidden.
integrity.requirement.evidence: A minimum count of evidence items
integrity.requirement.response: A solicited response, or an expired response window
reports.footer.why: The document carries the chain root and a verify URL. A report that carries its own proof is a different category of object from a report that carries a logo.
roles.why: The role changes the shell, not only the permissions. Field staff never see a kanban; they see three jobs and a camera.
roles.commissioner.can: Read, approve policy, co-sign a blacklist, export
roles.field.can: Capture evidence and update status, on a phone
roles.auditor.can: Export and build case files — never mutate
roles.contractor.can: Upload evidence, respond to a flag, appeal
roles.support.sees: Cross-tenant, with impersonation audited and visible to the tenant
gap.rateCard: a rate card and a Schedule of Rates figure
gap.milestones: milestone records and the evidence that opens them
gap.signals: integrity detectors, their thresholds and their confidence
gap.caseFile: a case file, its findings and its approvers
gap.report: a report definition and its rendered document
gap.repeatDefect: repeat defects within ninety days of closure
gap.underreporting: reports per road-kilometre, and the city median to compare them against
policy.baseline: Platform baseline — this tenant has not authored a document for this kind.
policy.diff.none: Nothing changed between these two revisions.
policy.diff.first: This is the first revision, so there is nothing to compare it against.
policy.none: This tenant has authored no revisions of this kind.
backtest.title: Backtest
backtest.run: Run against a labelled set to see what this would have changed.
backtest.result: This revision would have decided {affected} of {cases} historical complaints differently, out of a population of {population}.
backtest.none: This revision has never been run against a labelled set.
backtest.coverage: A run with a coverage gap cannot certify anything, because a certificate would attest to a check that did not happen.
activate.title: Activation
activate.blocked: This kind is gated by the published evaluation set {code}. A revision with no passing certificate against it cannot be activated.
activate.blockedWhy: The refusal is the server's, not this screen's. The control is disabled here so the rule is legible before it is hit; the same request from a script is refused by the control plane.
activate.allowed: No evaluation set is published for this kind, so nothing gates this activation. Publishing a set is how a tenant turns the gate on.
activate.reload: This process serves the new version immediately. Other workers pick it up within one reload interval.
tuning.title: What the reverted merges suggest
tuning.direction: Thresholds can only be proposed upward. The log records merges operators reverted; nothing records merges that should have happened and did not.
tuning.row: {category}: {current} to {proposed}, from {reverts} reverted merges, the highest of which was confident at {highest}.
tuning.none: No band has enough reverted merges to propose anything. Below the evidence floor there is no proposal, not a weak one.
shadow.title: Shadow mode
shadow.rate: {diverged} of {observed} observations diverged from the active policy.
control.taxonomy.name: Display name
control.taxonomy.added: Defined. The classifier picks it up on its next reload.
control.coverage.missing: {count} keys still in the source language
control.tenant.name: Name
control.publication.why: Publishing is an act somebody takes, logged with a required justification and revocable through the same door. It is not a configuration flag.
control.publication.noRead: The control plane publishes no read endpoint for a tenant's publication state, so this panel can set it and cannot show it. What a tenant currently publishes is visible on the public surface itself.
control.unavailable: This panel could not be read. The rest of the screen is unaffected.
dev.keys.name: Name
queue.title: Queue
queue.label: Review queue, sorted by time remaining then severity
queue.empty: Nothing is waiting. That is a real state, not a loading one.
queue.unavailable: The queue could not be read. Nothing has been decided in the meantime.
strip.title: Before anything else
strip.uncertified: {count} has no contractor certified for this category.
strip.clear: Nothing breaches in the next 24 hours.
strip.breachPending: How many reports breach their deadline in the next 24 hours, how many of those are unassigned, and how many have no certified contractor for their category. The contract carries no deadline, no assignment and no certification yet, so this line states what it will say rather than estimating it.
map.title: The city
map.peers: The same places, as a list
map.empty: No place in this city has a published location yet, so there is nothing to draw. The queue below is unaffected.
evidence.title: Evidence
print.title: {screen} — {city}
print.legend: Severity is printed as a shape as well as an ink, so this page survives a grayscale printer.
state.error: That did not load. Nothing was changed.
state.roadmapValues: The shape is real and generated from the contract. The values on this screen are fixtures until the phase named on the chip lands.
queue.quiet: Nothing is waiting on a decision right now.
roadmap.phaseLine: Phase {phase} populates this screen's contract. Until it does, every value above is a fixture behind a published type — the shape is real and the numbers are not.
roadmap.until: What this city publishes about the same subject today
